svg.title: Everything else OmacVM does
svg.desc: A grid of eight small animated tiles. 1. Clipboard both ways: a line copied in Omarchy flies to the Mac and is pasted with Command+V, then a line copied on the Mac is pasted into Omarchy's terminal with Command+V. 2. Wi-Fi sharing: macOS first asks for approval, then Omarchy shows its QR card for the Mac's network. 3. AirPods connect to the Mac and Omarchy's audio output menu switches to them. 4. The wallpaper follows the theme: Omarchy switches theme and the Mac's desktop wallpaper changes to match. 5. Each display has its own workspaces; unplugging the external display parks its workspaces on the built-in display and plugging it back restores them. 6. The keyboard layout is taken from the Mac: German on the Mac becomes de in Omarchy and umlauts type correctly. 7. The VM is one icon in the macOS Dock: OmacVM. 8. One command: omacvm runs through its steps and finishes.
